object_description: compact low-rise volume with a folded roof
design_condition: Placed north of the existing sports and swimming-pool buildings, the extension establishes northern access, a western arrival and break area, and a protected eastern outdoor space while reconnecting the campus to surrounding neighbourhoods.

positive.statement: The fundamentally coherent urban development and open-space concept integrate well into the existing facility.

position.rationale: The northern extension and surrounding campus spaces are anchored at the upper site edge.

positive.statement: The light-flooded studio-school idea creates a stimulating atmosphere through two-sided illumination and skylights.

position.rationale: The central upper volume is used for the studio-school daylight concept.

positive.statement: The careful architectural processing and stringent constructive design are highly convincing.

position.rationale: Compact massing and folded roof construction are clearly visible across the calibrated views.

positive.statement: The building structure allows the required extension to be added horizontally in a straightforward way.

position.rationale: The extension potential is anchored toward the eastern horizontal building end.

negative.statement: The inner access and cloakroom zone is very cramped and difficult to integrate into everyday teaching.

position.rationale: The internal arrival zone is approximated near the western entry side.

negative.statement: The urban-planning setting reaches its limits, particularly in connection with the expansion phase.

position.rationale: Expansion pressure is anchored at the northern and eastern limits of the compact footprint.

negative.statement: The new connection, tree-row break, stairs, and narrow sidewalk arrival raise questions of presence and scale.

position.target: new connection, tree-row break, stairs, and sidewalk arrival
position.rationale: Arrival elements are approximated along the western edge of the extension.

negative.statement: The transition to the new building appears somewhat sudden.

position.rationale: The abrupt transition is localized at the western receiving facade.

negative.statement: The spatial program is implemented very tightly in some areas, while the envelope expenditure is well above average.

position.rationale: Tight planning and enlarged envelope are assessed across the visible compact building mass.
